_note: 20 LLM-generated factors that PASS the strict factor_lab gate (VW FF5+UMD full+OOS + monotone).

factors.name: mispr_fin_disc
factors.rationale: Stambaugh-Yuan mispricing reverses more strongly among firms with restrained equity issuance and asset growth (q-theory discipline).

factors.name: mispr_fin_disc_quality
factors.rationale: Mispricing reversal is cleaner when supported by real gross profitability alongside financing and investment discipline.

factors.name: mispr_noa_disc
factors.rationale: Mispricing combined with low net operating assets (Hirshleifer bloat) and low issuance targets over-accruing over-valued firms.

factors.name: cash_prof_accrual_quality
factors.rationale: Ball et al. cash-based profitability with low operating accruals (Sloan) and disciplined issuance = high-quality real earnings.

factors.name: cashprof_lowissue_value
factors.rationale: Cheap, cash-profitable firms that neither issue equity nor grow share count combine value, quality, and financing discipline.

factors.name: ev_value_cashprof
factors.rationale: Enterprise-multiple value (EBIT/book-EV) is cleaner than book-to-market for levered firms; plus cash profitability and low investment.

factors.name: ebitda_value_quality
factors.rationale: EBITDA-to-market-EV value tilted toward quality profitability, penalizing equity issuance.

factors.name: shareholder_yield_quality
factors.rationale: Net payout yield (Boudoukh) plus cash profitability, penalizing issuance: firms returning cash and generating real profits.

factors.name: quality_bloat_value
factors.rationale: Asness quality (profitability + safety) tilted to cheap sales-to-price and low balance-sheet bloat (NOA anomaly).

factors.name: issuance_mom_reversal
factors.rationale: Low equity and debt financing plus intermediate momentum, guarded against short-term reversal = capital discipline + underreaction.

factors.name: persistent_mispricing_disc
factors.rationale: Persistent (not transient) mispricing plus persistently low issuance identifies durable anomaly exposure.

factors.name: earnings_yield_stability
factors.rationale: Earnings yield scaled by earnings volatility rewards stable high-yield earners (quality of E/P), plus cash profitability.

factors.name: mispr_profit_lowrisk
factors.rationale: Mispricing supported by profitability and concentrated in low-idio-vol, more investable names.

factors.name: debt_discipline_value
factors.rationale: Low debt issuance and leverage with value and cash profitability captures conservatively financed cheap firms.

factors.name: coa_growth_quality
factors.rationale: Change in current operating assets and asset growth are overinvestment signals; cash profitability offsets them.

factors.name: quality_growth_value
factors.rationale: Profitability quality and ROE tilted to cheap sales-to-price and low bloat.

factors.name: mispr_mgmt_accrual
factors.rationale: The management mispricing cluster (net issuance, accruals, investment) reinforced by low accruals, low issuance, profitability.

factors.name: mispr_fin_disc_op
factors.rationale: Mispricing reversal with financing and investment discipline, reinforced by operating profitability.

factors.name: mispr_sale_growth_disc
factors.rationale: Mispricing combined with low issuance and restrained sales growth (revenue-side overexpansion).

factors.name: cashprof_taccruals_disc
factors.rationale: Cash profitability with low total accruals and disciplined issuance = high-quality real earnings.
